mapper.sql: id, status, scope, data_scope, owner_token, completed_units, total_units, message, evidence_sha256, created_at, started_at, finished_at, heartbeat_at, deadline_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO research_validation_task(status, scope, data_scope, active_key, request_json) VALUES('PENDING', #{scope}, #{dataScope}, #{activeKey}, #{requestJson})
mapper.select: SELECT , request_json, summary_json FROM research_validation_task WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT , request_json FROM research_validation_task ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_validation_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')
SELECT , request_json, summary_json FROM research_validation_task WHERE active_key=#{key}
SELECT MIN(id) FROM research_validation_task WHERE status='PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE research_validation_task SET status='RUNNING', owner_token=#{owner}, started_at=#{now}, heartbeat_at=#{now}, deadline_at=#{deadline}, message='开始读取冻结请求' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE research_validation_task SET heartbeat_at=#{now}, completed_units=#{completed}, total_units=#{total}, message=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' THEN #{message} ELSE message END, status=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' AND deadline_at <= #{now} THEN 'TIMEOUT_REQUESTED' ELSE status END WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND status IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')

UPDATE research_validation_task SET finished_at=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN #{now} ELSE finished_at END, active_key=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN NULL ELSE active_key END, message='用户已请求取消验证', status=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' END WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')

UPDATE research_validation_task SET completed_units=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' AND #{status}='SUCCESS' AND deadline_at > #{now} THEN 1 ELSE completed_units END, total_units=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' AND #{status}='SUCCESS' AND deadline_at > #{now} THEN 1 ELSE total_units END, evidence_json=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' AND #{status}='SUCCESS' AND deadline_at > #{now} THEN #{evidence} ELSE NULL END, summary_json=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' AND #{status}='SUCCESS' AND deadline_at > #{now} THEN #{summary} ELSE NULL END, evidence_sha256=CASE WHEN status='RUNNING' AND #{status}='SUCCESS' AND deadline_at > #{now} THEN #{evidenceHash} ELSE NULL END, message=CASE WHEN status='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN '验证已取消' WHEN status='TIMEOUT_REQUESTED' OR deadline_at <= #{now} THEN '验证超过执行时限' ELSE #{message} END, status=CASE WHEN status='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN status='TIMEOUT_REQUESTED' OR deadline_at <= #{now} THEN 'TIMED_OUT' ELSE #{status} END, active_key=NULL, finished_at=#{now}, heartbeat_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND status IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')

UPDATE research_validation_task SET message='原执行进程心跳失联，未发布成功证据', status=CASE WHEN status='CANCEL_REQUESTED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN status='TIMEOUT_REQUESTED' THEN 'TIMED_OUT' ELSE 'INTERRUPTED' END, active_key=NULL, finished_at=#{now}, owner_token=NULL WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED') AND heartbeat_at < #{staleBefore}
mapper.select: SELECT evidence_json FROM research_validation_task WHERE id=#{id} AND status='SUCCESS'
